text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.

Enough to start. Charter recorded: one-page site with menu, hours, location, pickup pre-order, a large gallery and three farm stories. Facts we don't have (prices, hours, farm names, photos) will show as marked placeholders. @Adaptation, propose workflows.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Four workflows cover the full charter scope for 60 against a 50 budget; rate-card minimum is 60 because hours and location share one section part. Cheapest cut if Priority must: none keeps done-when intact, so I ask for a counter rather than dropping the gallery or farms. Order: W1, W2, then W3 and W4.

proposal.name: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location
proposal.goal_gap: No page exists: no nav, menu, hours or location sections.
proposal.expected_outcome: Single HTML file with viewport meta, responsive CSS breakpoints, anchor nav, a menu section with categories and placeholder prices, and hours and location sections (separate anchors) with marked placeholders and a directions link placeholder.
proposal.completion_check: File has viewport meta, at least one @media breakpoint, nav links to #menu #hours #location #preorder #gallery #farms, menu with at least 2 categories, hours and location sections present, every unknown value visibly marked as placeholder.

proposal.name: Pickup pre-order form
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot build an order or get a summary to send.
proposal.expected_outcome: Browser-only pre-order section: pick items and quantities from the menu, choose pickup time, see running total or item list, and generate an order summary for a send channel placeholder (WhatsApp or email).
proposal.completion_check: Item quantities update a visible total or list, a pickup time field exists, a Generate summary button produces text containing items, quantities and pickup time, and send channel and time rules are marked placeholders.

proposal.name: Large photo gallery
proposal.expected_outcome: Responsive gallery grid with 12 image slots, each with alt text, loading=lazy and a visible Photo placeholder label.
proposal.completion_check: Count of gallery img or slot elements is at least 12; each has non-empty alt and loading=lazy; each is visibly marked as placeholder.

proposal.name: Three farm stories
proposal.expected_outcome: Three separate farm entries, each with name, location, story text and photo slot, all as marked placeholders until facts are supplied.
proposal.completion_check: Exactly 3 farm entries, each containing name, location, story and photo slot elements; all values visibly marked placeholder; no invented farm facts.

text: @Adaptation COUNTER: all four workflows stay, total 50 against a 50 budget. Two cuts of 5 each: (1) drop the separate styling part from W1, since the baseline CSS and the breakpoints come with the page sections; (2) cost W2 as one interactive_feature, because a browser-only order builder with no submit or backend is not a form. If you think W2 is a true form, say why, and the fallback is to park W4 (farms) until budget frees up. Trade-off: zero reserve, so retry_limit is 0 and there is no money for a fix (8). Nothing may exceed its envelope.

@Identity All 10 done-when items hold. One warning on item 5: the Send to Brew Lab button is visible with no send channel set, because `.btn{display:inline-block}` overrides the `hidden` attribute. It opens a blank tab labelled as sending. The fix is one CSS line (`[hidden]{display:none!important}`), but a fix costs 8 and the budget is 0, so this needs your call. I have not confirmed it in a browser.
